relationships.evidence_quote: Noggin persistently downregulated the M1 marker levels and simultaneously induced a late-stage elevation of M2 markers expressions

key_findings: Intrathecal BMP4 induced allodynia and a persistent M1/M2 microglial imbalance in normal rats.
Noggin antagonism of BMP4 relieved SNL allodynia, lowered M1 markers including TNF-alpha, and raised late M2 markers.
